Fix: - sgt/core/mine.py: a path renamed out of .sgt/ (git detected .sgt/frontier.json → .sgt.bak/frontier.json as a 100%-similarity rename in the user's history) now stays excluded for the rest of that mine() call, via a new excluded_paths set threaded through _mine_one. Previously only the rename touch itself was skipped, leaving the destination path unexcluded — so a later plain delete of it mined a prune op with no producing "add" anywhere, breaking downward-closure. - sgt/cli.py: sgt init now parses --horizon <ref> (via the existing _strip_opt helper) and passes it to lens.init(). Previously the flag was silently swallowed as the positional repo path, creating a bogus nested repo at ./--horizon/ with no error. - Updated the sgt init help line accordingly.

compelte U7: revert_keep_dependents now drafts real hollows only for direct reference-edge dependents, while transitive dependents are recorded in draft.meta["carry_forward"] and mechanically re-minted by build_candidate with identical content and cleared requires — mirroring split-op's existing tail pattern. This required zero changes to sgt/repair/ itself, since repair() only ever iterates draft.hollow_ids; the transitive tail resolves before the repair loop or backend ever sees a request, so backend.calls stays constant regardless of chain depth (verified directly by the new test_transitive_dependent_survives_without_costing_a_backend_call).
